issues.description: The script requests broad network access via @connect *, allowing GM_xmlhttpRequest to any domain. This can be abused for data exfiltration.
issues.recommendation: Restrict @connect to only necessary domains. Remove wildcard if not strictly needed.

issues.description: The script requests high-privilege grants such as GM_download, GM_openInTab, GM_setClipboard, and unsafeWindow, which can be abused if the script is compromised.
issues.recommendation: Only request the minimum necessary permissions. Remove unused or high-risk grants.

issues.description: The script loads external dependencies via @require from update.greasyfork.org, which is generally trusted but not version-pinned with integrity hashes.
issues.recommendation: Pin dependencies to specific versions and verify their integrity. Consider using official CDNs with SRI hashes if possible.

summary: Picviewer CE+ requests broad network access (@connect *) and several high-privilege grants, which increases the risk of data exfiltration and abuse if the script or its dependencies are compromised. No direct privacy collection or DOM XSS risks were found in the provided code. The script is not obfuscated. Supply chain risk exists due to external dependencies not being pinned with integrity hashes. Restrict network permissions, minimize grants, and pin dependencies to improve security.
